facts.text: panda-reach-v0 is registered with the entry point gym_panda_reach.envs:PandaEnv
gym_panda_reach.envs re-exports PandaEnv from panda_env
PandaEnv is a gym.Env
The constructor connects to PyBullet in GUI mode, so creating the environment needs pybullet and a display
The action space is Box([-1, -1, -1, -1], [1, 1, 1, 1]): four continuous values from -1 to 1
The observation space is declared as Box([-1] * 24, [1] * 24)
Each step moves the end effector by action[0], action[1] and action[2] times dv = 0.05 in x, y and z and takes action[3] as the finger command
The end effector is link 11 and its target pose is solved with calculateInverseKinematics for the incremented position with a fixed orientation
Joints 0 to 6 are position-controlled at the inverse-kinematics solution and joints 9 and 10 at action[3]
One step advances the simulation once with p.stepSimulation()
The reach threshold is distance 0.05 between the end effector and the object; the episode is done when the distance is below it
The dense reward is minus the distance; the sparse reward is -1 when the distance is above 0.05 and 0 otherwise
MAX_EPISODE_LEN is 20 * 100 = 2000 steps
The episode is also done when step_counter is greater than MAX_EPISODE_LEN, so a run stops on the 2001st step

The observation has 24 values: grip position, object position, their difference, mean finger position, object orientation, object linear and angular velocity, commanded xyz velocity and finger velocity
reset loads the Panda at base z 0.65 with the rest pose [0, -0.215, 0, -2.57, 0, 2.356, pi/4, 0, 0, 0]
The object starts uniformly at x in [0.5, 0.8], y in [-0.2, 0.2] and z in [0.65, 0.85]
The goal object is loaded with useFixedBase=True, so it does not move during an episode
The step result is the legacy 4-tuple (observation, reward, done, info)
reset takes no seed or options argument
reset returns the observation alone, not an (observation, info) pair
The object position is reported in info as object_position
render returns a 720 by 960 RGB array from getCameraImage
close disconnects the PyBullet client

determinism.notes: the fake draws the object start from Python's random.Random(seed); the upstream reset takes no seed and draws from the module-level random generator (panda_env.py:136,202-204), so the seed is applied by this package's fake only, not by the PyBullet environment

gaps: kinematic fake: the end effector moves exactly by action * 0.05 and the object is fixed; PyBullet rigid-body dynamics, contacts, inverse kinematics and joint limits are not modelled
one step() call is one control event and no simulated time is modelled, so timestep_ms is 0
the upstream environment opens a PyBullet GUI in its constructor (panda_env.py:26-29) and needs pybullet, gym and a display; it was never opened or compared with this fake
the upstream reset takes no seed and places the object with the module-level random generator; the seeded reset is the fake's extension
the fake does not render: it has no render() and returns no image, while the upstream render() returns a 720x960 RGB array (panda_env.py:249-273)
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
